assets.name: skin
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production raster UI skin atlas for a cute goblin pixel-art mobile game. Reference is STYLE ONLY, extract NO scene, no characters, no buildings. Make a standalone transparent-background sprite sheet, exactly FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, equal cells, generous transparent spacing. Each cell contains one complete independent UI element, centered and strictly confined to its cell. Clean chunky pixel art, low resolution aesthetic, crisp stepped edges, 2 or 3 flat tones only, NO gradients, NO grain, NO noise, no ornate tiny decoration. Dark teal, warm oak wood, gold and royal purple. Each component should look drawn at about64x64 logical pixels. Row1 left to right: 1 square dark teal modal panel with thick brown wood border and square reinforced corners, flat plain empty center suitable for nine-slice stretching; 2 plain gold rectangular button with dark stepped outer edge and pale yellow inner border; 3 plain brown wood rectangular button with dark stepped edge; 4 plain purple rectangular button with lavender inner edge. Row2 left to right: 5 plain green rectangular button; 6 plain red/brown square close-button background NO X; 7 small square dark-teal utility-button background with muted brass border; 8 blank dark-teal HUD panel with thin brass/wood border, all corners confined to cell. Row3 left to right: 9 circular stepped-pixel dark-teal joystick base with muted green rim and four small cream direction triangles at N/S/E/W, empty center; 10 separate round cream joystick thumb with chunky stepped silhouette; 11 short wide blank red title ribbon with simple square notches; 12 short wide blank purple title ribbon with simple square notches. All buttons blank without icons. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO labels, NO demonstration screen, NO mockup. Panel border thickness relatively uniform; avoid internal decorations so nine-slice regions stretch cleanly. True transparent alpha outside each component.

assets.name: title
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: finished transparent PNG title logo for a cute goblin pixel-art game. Use reference ONLY for chunky fantasy game-title style and gold/purple colors. Exact Chinese game name is “我是哥布林：魔王”. The logo must show ONLY the characters 我 是 哥 布 林 ： 魔 王, spelled correctly, no extra words, English, tagline or punctuation. Compose two readable lines: upper line “我是哥布林”, slightly smaller but still bold chunky gold pixel lettering; lower line “魔王” much larger in vivid purple/lavender pixel lettering. A small visible Chinese colon “：” links the two lines in the center gap. A tiny gold crown sits over the lettering, and just one small simple green goblin ear shape on each side. Backing is a restrained dark charcoal stepped plaque silhouette hugging the lettering, NOT a large illustrated castle, no scenery, no character illustration. Make the actual Chinese characters the hero of the design. Flat coarse pixel art, sharp stair-step outlines, clear large pixel clusters, 2-3 flat shades per color. No smooth gradients, no noise or dithering, no tiny details, no glow. Overall wide rectangle around 2:1 aspect, snug composition with small transparent margins, on genuinely transparent background. Readable at 280 CSS pixels wide.

assets.name: icons
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone production UI ICON SPRITE ATLAS for cute goblin pixel game. Transparent background, exactly FIVE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS,20 equally spaced icon cells, every icon centered entirely inside its own cell with generous transparent margins. Each icon bold and immediately readable at24x24px: clean coarse pixel art, strong dark outline, at most3flat shades per material. Crisp square pixel clusters, no blur no gradients no grain no text labels no surrounding button backgrounds. Row1 left-right: gold coin, gold crown, diagonal silver sword, red heart, steel blue shield. Row2 left-right: cream video-play triangle, cream pause symbol two bars, cream close X, green healing plus, wooden bow with arrow. Row3 left-right: gold double chevrons speed, purple starburst magic, cyan snowflake, cute green goblin face, cream loudspeaker with soundwaves. Row4 left-right: small cream house, simple brown/silver hammer, purple flag, small stone arrowtower, cream question mark. Exactly these20icons no additional items or decorative background. Icons all same visual weight, simple bright silhouettes, matching dark teal brown gold purple forest-game UI reference.

assets.name: level-flag
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single production game HUD world-space level flag sprite, transparent background. A small cute fantasy goblin standard: thin straight dark brown wooden pole at left topped with a tiny gold knob, rectangular royal-purple hanging flag to its right, simple flat lavender inner border and one V notch at the bottom. Large completely blank flat dark-purple center area for overlaying one cream digit in code. No symbols, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, no crown, no scenery, no base rocks, no shadows outside the flag. Vertical compact silhouette, designed at about20x28 logical pixels enlarged with nearest-neighbor chunky pixel edges. Strong clean outline, only2flatshades of each color, no gradients no grain no blur no glow. Flag upright and perfectly readable, no flutter or perspective. Fill the canvas with small transparent margins. Matching the attached cute pixel fantasy UI, but very simple and flat.
